title: Brasswort
description: A low FM bass carrier wearing a shifting vowel mask, so it talks in metallic vowels while the pitch envelope snaps and sags underneath. Over 16 cycles the FM index climbs, the vowels rotate a/e/o/u, the filter sweeps and the pitch-morph deepens, turning a clean fm bass into a buzzing brass-throated growl.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(2, 11)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .vowel("<a e o u>/2")
    .penv("<0 7 -5 12>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(sine.slow(24).range(0.06, 0.22))
    .bpf(sine.slow(32).range(220, 2600)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(3).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.22).sustain(0.55).release(0.07)
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.5)).crush("<16 8 6>/16")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.25).vowel("i"))
    .room(0.2).gain(0.9)
)
